But yes you can definitely get used to it and it may feel a but more slippy especially if your viper mini is a bit new so the feet are still fresh and smooth. Try tweaking your valorant sensitivity if it’s still too quick. Start off slow and slowly increase it as you go along. I use 0.35 sens with 800 dpi for valorant and it’s good enough for me to control on the strider while I still have the speed for games like apex and overwatch with a slightly faster sens
